provenance: User-reported multimeter readings; not independently instrumented by assistant
orientation: Photo has antenna at top and USB-C at bottom; measured small horizontal two-terminal component to the right of VIN silkscreen, below the larger regulator-adjacent component.

derived.supported: The two terminals are mapped to VBUS and VIN; powered voltage drop is consistent with a forward diode path.

contradiction_to_resolve: Both diode-mode readings were OL although the board powers over USB. Do not treat these readings as proof of reverse blocking or declare the component faulty.
